prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted 2D tactical RPG SPRITE SHEET. Muted dark-fantasy painted steel/leather/fur, warm upper-left light, restrained ink-like edges, realistic natural proportions, clearly painted rather than glossy 3D. Orthographic shallow elevated tactical camera about18degrees, EVERY figure faces front-right three-quarter SOUTH EAST. Fixed camera and identical body scale. Exactly4 columns by4 rows,16 separated complete figures, transparent alpha, NO floor/shadow/text/labels/grid/colored fringe. Generous space and no touching silhouettes. Natural feet, readable face/gloves, consistent equipment. Large square sheet, body at least230px high in each human cell. Do not crop any feet/head/weapon. EDIT the supplied painted reference into a NEW enemy bandit archer animation sheet, matching this game's painted finish. He is distinct from Torin: lean angular adult man, short black stubble, faded BURGUNDY hood, weathered dark brown patched leather jerkin, charcoal trousers, modest leather boots and bracer/gloves, plain wooden longbow in left hand and quiver on back. No blue/gold knight costume and no green hood. Same identity throughout. Row1: FOUR calm idle breathing poses with bow lowered at side, feet unmoving in natural stance. Rows2-3: EIGHT sequential IN-PLACE WALK poses, left/right feet alternating naturally through a full cycle, relaxed lowered bow, no running, same head scale. Row4: FOUR COMBAT READY idle breathing poses with bow held diagonally in front, arrow ready but string NOT fully drawn, both feet planted. Neutral posture straight legs, combat stance modestly wide. Full-body bow and quiver included in all16cells.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied sixteen-cell character reference into a NEW ACTION SPRITE SHEET of EXACTLY THE SAME character, face, clothing, equipment, material shading and anatomy. Keep art style. Fixed shallow elevated orthographic SOUTH EAST front-right camera in EVERY cell; no back/profile turn. Exact4columns by4rows16 separate complete full-body drawings, generous empty spacing, identical body scale/camera, transparent alpha, no floor/text/shadow/grid/colored fringe. Large square. Include all weapon tips and feet. Chronological articulated poses with torso/hip/shoulder weight transfer; not moving a static cutout. Keep burgundy hood/brown patched leather, slim bandit face, wooden bow/quiver. TOP TWO ROWS8cells: full COMBAT WALK cycle, bow prepared diagonally before torso but not fully drawn, natural alternating footfalls at walking pace, legs not sprinting. BOTTOM TWO ROWS8cells ONE bow shot: 1 nock arrow with bowlow, 2 raise bow, 3 draw halfway with rear elbow rising, 4 full draw HAND ANCHORED AT CHEEK and rear elbow HIGH near eye level, 5 hold full aiming pose with bent wooden limbs and taut pulled string, 6 RELEASE arrow while bow arm remains extended/rear hand follows beside cheek, 7 relaxed follow-through and return bow, 8 return initial ready/nocking stance. Bow stays in LEFT hand, right fingers draw string; arrow points toward screen-right slightly down toward imagined target. Full-body action in all8cells, distinct drawing for release; bow/arrow geometry credible and consistent size.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied sixteen-cell character reference into a NEW ACTION SPRITE SHEET of EXACTLY THE SAME character, face, clothing, equipment, material shading and anatomy. Keep art style. Fixed shallow elevated orthographic SOUTH EAST front-right camera in EVERY cell; no back/profile turn. Exact4columns by4rows16 separate complete full-body drawings, generous empty spacing, identical body scale/camera, transparent alpha, no floor/text/shadow/grid/colored fringe. Large square. Include all weapon tips and feet. Chronological articulated poses with torso/hip/shoulder weight transfer; not moving a static cutout. Keep exact burgundy-hood bandit, same bow/quiver/face/boots. Row1 FOUR standing defensive/sidestep poses, body still upright, preserve original body height: brace, lean back, return, standing reference. Row2 FOUR hit/recoil poses: shoulder hit, lean torso back while feet brace, recover balance, settle. Rows3-4 EIGHT DEATH/FALL poses: hit, head/shoulders drop, knees buckle, one knee touches floor, free hand reaches down, body falls to side, body lands, final rests prone/on side. Body articulates at knees/hips/spine; NOT rotating an upright sprite. The final horizontal body uses the SAME adult body size, bow lies naturally alongside body, no duplicated arms/weapons/heads, no miniature squashed corpse. Every full body, quiver and complete bow fits its cell. No blood/wounds/gore.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production hand-painted2D dark-fantasy tactical RPG animation sheet, matching realistic painted leather/steel human game sprites but a natural ANATOMICAL ADULT WOLF. Grey-brown coarse fur, charcoal saddle along back, tawny flanks, pale throat/muzzle, small amber eyes, natural large paws and low relaxed bushy tail. Wolf has exactlyFOUR legs, long canine body and muzzle, natural ears, NO armor/collar/props, NO human anatomy. Fixed orthographic shallow elevated camera about18degrees, front-right3/4 SOUTH EAST, head points screen-right in ALL cells. Exactly4columns by4rows16 separated complete animals, very generous empty cells, large square canvas. Equal anatomical body size throughout, muzzle/tail/fourpaws fully visible. Actual transparent alpha, NO floor/shadows/text/grid. Real painted fur volumes and controlled sharp edges, subdued warm upper-left light, not photoreal fur noise, not glossy3D, not chibi. Row1: FOUR relaxed idle breathing poses with all four paws firmly planted and restrained tail. Rows2-3: EIGHT consecutive IN-PLACE natural canine WALK poses: four anatomically attached legs alternate through support/swing, subtle weight transfer through shoulders/hips, level spine/head, no bounding/running/hopping, no duplicate near legs, no camera translation. Row4: FOUR combat-ready idle poses, alert low forward head with slightly braced forelegs and open tense muzzle, all four paws planted. Keep body size identical to relaxed stance; ready stance is a small natural crouch, not a tiny wolf.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied wolf reference into a NEW quadruped animation sheet of the EXACT SAME adult grey-brown wolf, charcoal saddle/tawny flank/pale muzzle/amber eyes, anatomical FOUR legs, low bushy tail, same painted fur/style. NO human movement, props/armor, extra legs/heads/tails. Fixed orthographic shallow elevated SOUTH EAST front-right3/4 camera, head toward screen-right throughout. Exactly4columns x4rows16 COMPLETE clearly separated animals, large square, same anatomical body SCALE and generous cell margins so MUZZLE/TAIL/PAWS are never clipped even in last column. TRUE transparent alpha, no red/green fringe, floor, shadow, text or grid. TOP TWO ROWS8cells: full ALERT WALK cycle with head somewhat lower/forward, natural alternating canine legs, grounded paw contacts through shoulders/hips, level back, restrained tail, no sprint/bounce. BOTTOM TWO ROWS8cells ONE BITE ATTACK: 1 braced ready, 2 weight shifts onto hindlegs and shoulders lower, 3 crouched anticipation with forelegs bent and head poised, 4 short forward lunge with front paws reaching toward target and mouth opening, 5 jaws close in a clear bite/contact with neck extended, 6 front paws land absorbing weight, 7 head retracts/body recovers balance, 8 initial four-paw ready stance. Genuine articulated shoulders/hips/leg positions, not translation/rotation of static art. Constant body size, all paws and tail inside cell. No prey, gore or blood.
